detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Game Description

Re 2: I  Rise Alone is a brand-new innovative game that combines romance, simulation, exploration, and interactive cinematic elements. You will play as "yourself," rising from a nobody at the bottom all the way to the spectacular transformation into the CEO of a publicly listed company.

Game Features

💖 10+ Romanceable Heroines
You can choose to focus on one, or try to "have them all" — it's entirely up to you.

📽️ Multiple Playstyles + Loaded with "Satisfying Moments"

  • Live-action combat system: Bone-crunching action with realistic impact

  • Drinking & flirting system: A single drink tells how deep your bond really is

  • 1000+ interactive moments — each one cost the dev team a ton of hair (literally)

🎮 Simulation System × Free Exploration
Improve your stats — strength, charm, intelligence, etc. — through dialogue and events. Different attributes affect story branches and endings. Freely explore the city map to unlock main storylines, side quests, and even hidden missions.

💰 Money-Making & Item System
Work part-time, invest, complete missions to earn money, buy items and equipment, boost your abilities will determine your final ending.

🎁 300+ Easter Eggs
From films and short videos to classic games, over 300 carefully hidden easter eggs await you.

The road to a comeback offers more than one way to live.
Will you become a lonely winner, or a ladies' man with the beauties by your side? Your choice determines the ending.
